title: Learning How to Stand Here
style: Indie-pop / it-pop with a youthful female lead vocal, intimate and observant delivery. Mid-tempo loping groove, crisp dry kit and handclaps, rounded bass, bright muted guitar, small piano accents, occasional airy woodwind answers. Verses stay close and conversational, pre-chorus gradually opens, chorus lifts with stacked harmonies and a memorable repeated phrase; bridge strips back to voice and keys before a full final chorus. Warm, detailed modern production with human timing and clear storytelling.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Blue hard hat, afternoon sun
You hand me papers, say, “You’ve got this one”
The city’s still a promise drawn in sand
I write it down faster than my tablet can
Beach in the morning, meetings after noon
Spanish comes easier beneath this room
At night I sort the day into a page
A little less a visitor with every age

[Pre-Chorus]
I thought grown-up was a color I could wear
A white one waiting somewhere over there
But you pass me the work, and I begin
To trust the shape of who I’m growing in

[Chorus]
I’m learning how to stand here
With the tide still on my shoes
I can speak for myself now
I can choose what I will do
And when the whole room turns to me
I don’t disappear
I’m learning how to stand here
I’m already here

[Verse 2]
Friday, salt and sun, then back to town
Suitcases gather, goodbyes move around
Next week they’ll cross the coast and fly back north
New faces come when the year turns over
Then suddenly the door swings wide again
My iaia, cousins, laughter in the hall
I missed the teasing more than I let on
Some feelings don’t need saying after all

[Pre-Chorus]
At mass they walk together through the square
My mother draws the glances everywhere
I catch a little understanding in her eyes
Or maybe I’m just making up a sign

[Chorus]
I’m learning how to stand here
With the tide still on my shoes
I can speak for myself now
I can choose what I will do
And when the whole room turns to me
I don’t disappear
I’m learning how to stand here
I’m already here

[Bridge]
Babbu, lo so, sono ancora tua figlia
Ma sto crescendo, guarda come cambio
You came to see the work, and stayed to see
The person I am making out of me
My tablet knows the marks I make by hand
It keeps the little sounds I hadn’t planned
You say let something else translate the day
I keep my notes; I like them my own way

[Final Chorus]
I’m learning how to stand here
With the tide still on my shoes
I can speak for myself now
I can choose what I will do
And when the whole room turns to me
I don’t disappear
I’m learning how to stand here
I’m already here

[Outro]
Blue hard hat, afternoon sun
I take the page and carry on
